main.description: Start a group on Grain's group host. The host creates the group with the viewer as its founder and hands Grain its own session on it (fyi.opensocial.provisionGroup); Grain then gives the group its pool and its Grain profile. The viewer never leaves Grain.

name.description: The first label of the group's handle, 3 to 18 characters; the host supplies its domain.

errors.name: InvalidName
errors.description: The name is not 3 to 18 letters, digits and hyphens, starting and ending with no hyphen.

errors.name: HandleUnavailable
errors.description: The group host refused the handle: taken, or not allowed.

errors.name: CreateFailed
errors.description: The group host did not start the group.

errors.name: PoolFailed
errors.description: The group was started, but its host did not open its pool.
